verdict.rationale: Belvo is an open-finance API platform, so a buyer could reasonably ask whether it lets customers choose a data storage region; the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents region selection or residency controls. Country-specific products (Brazil, Mexico, Chile) describe data sources, not where Belvo stores customer data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
